graph_diagnosis.summary: AI demand, Blackwell products, Data Center revenue, and non-Data-Center segment performance provide a reusable revenue-growth framework.
weaknesses: Market expectations are an indirect measure of operating performance.
Other-segment detail is less granular than Data Center evidence.

search_factors.why_search: AI adoption drives demand for Data Center products.
New-product uptake can lift Data Center sales.
Data Center sales are the main positive segment contributor.
Non-Data-Center segments determine whether segment strength translates into consolidated growth.
Expectations distinguish operating evidence from analyst sentiment.

checkpoints.mechanism: AI adoption increases demand for accelerator products.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Track customer demand and infrastructure spending.

checkpoints.mechanism: New accelerator products support Data Center sales.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Check product demand and shipment contribution.

checkpoints.mechanism: AI demand and product adoption convert into segment revenue.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Measure Data Center growth and share of consolidated revenue.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Segment sales do not match demand indicators.

checkpoints.mechanism: Slower non-Data-Center segments can restrain consolidated growth.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Compare each segment's growth and revenue weight.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Other segments accelerate with Data Center.

checkpoints.mechanism: High expectations can coexist with strong revenue that is lower than anticipated.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Compare consensus expectations with segment and consolidated results.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Expectations and operating indicators move together.

checkpoints.mechanism: Data Center and other segment contributions combine into consolidated year-over-year revenue growth.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Reconcile segment contributions and calculate consolidated year-over-year growth.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Segment trends do not reconcile to reported revenue.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: AI demand and product adoption support Data Center sales and consolidated revenue.
Slower growth outside Data Center restrains consolidated momentum.
applicability_conditions: Other segments retain a material revenue share.
failure_conditions: Other segments accelerate or become immaterial.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Data Center strength is sufficient to offset slower other segments.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Compare Data Center contribution with the weighted growth of other segments.

forecast_audit_questions: Is AI demand converting into Blackwell shipments?
Does Data Center growth dominate consolidated revenue?
Do other segments restrain aggregate growth?
Do segment results reconcile to consolidated growth?
